name: ui-api-automation-testing
description: UI + API test automation framework — Playwright + TypeScript, page objects, API service layer, multi-environment data, Allure reporting and CI on GitHub Actions
author: Thuong Nguyen

scripts.test:ui: playwright test --project="UI - Auth" --project="UI - Inventory" --project="UI - Cart" --project="UI - Checkout"
scripts.k6:smoke: mkdir -p reports/k6 && k6 run -e PROFILE=smoke k6/scenarios/products-api.js && k6 run -e PROFILE=smoke k6/scenarios/auth-flow.js
scripts.k6:load: mkdir -p reports/k6 && k6 run -e PROFILE=load k6/scenarios/products-api.js && k6 run -e PROFILE=load k6/scenarios/auth-flow.js
